description: This file defines the RScatter class for rendering scatter plots within the RGraph charting library. It includes methods for drawing the chart background, plotting data points, handling tooltips, and configuring chart properties.

classes.name: RGraph.RScatter
classes.description: Class for rendering scatter plot charts with interactive features, tooltips, and customizable properties within the RGraph library.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value or multiple properties via an object for configuration.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main method to render the scatter chart, including background, data points, labels, and titles.

methods.name: DrawBackground
methods.description: Draws the chart background, grid lines, axes, and optional grid diagonals and radials.

methods.name: DrawRscatter
methods.description: Plots the data points on the scatter chart based on the dataset.

methods.name: DrawLabels
methods.description: Draws axis labels, circular labels, and the chart key.

methods.name: DrawCircularLabels
methods.description: Draws labels around the circumference of the chart.

methods.name: DrawTick
methods.description: Draws individual tick marks on axes.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Returns shape information if the mouse is over a data point.

methods.name: getPoint
methods.description: Alias for getShape; retrieves point info based on mouse event.

methods.name: allowTooltips
methods.description: Enables tooltip functionality with event listeners.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights a specific data point or shape.

methods.name: getObjectByXY
methods.description: Returns the chart object if the mouse is within the chart's radius.

methods.name: positionTooltip
methods.description: Positions the tooltip element relative to the data point.

methods.name: getRadius
methods.description: Calculates the radius (distance from center) for a given data value.

methods.name: parseColors
methods.description: Parses color properties for gradients and stores original colors.

methods.name: parseSingleColorForGradient
methods.description: Converts a color string into a gradient object if specified.

methods.name: interactiveKeyHighlight
methods.description: Highlights all points in a data series for interactive key features.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Adds event listeners to the chart object.

methods.name: resetColorsToOriginalValues
methods.description: Resets data point colors to their original values.

methods.name: firstDrawFunc
methods.description: Placeholder for code to run once after initial drawing.
